comment: GooeyMB - Gooey's compressor in two bands for bass. A Linkwitz-Riley 24 dB/oct crossover (60-400 Hz) splits low and high; each band has Gooey's linked stereo detector (half peak, half RMS), soft knee, ratio, attack/release with program-dependent AUTO and a fixed auto makeup (a -6 dBFS level comes out at its level). A -1 dBFS output ceiling holds the attacks the makeup lifts. Mix is per band (parallel compression). Threshold 0 dB turns a band's compression off.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 947: free in every gid across the known collections (themanro/ZoomMultistompZDL docs/FXID-REGISTRY.md, 'Next available fxid', checked 2026-10-29). Pack IDs: 480 DualShft, 481 LOUDER, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 492 Washout, 493 Breather, 494 Takeoff, 495 GRDELAY, 496 Sweep, 497 Looper, 501 Gooey, 502 DJFilter.

params.name: LoThr
params.comment: Low band threshold, -40 to 0 dB in 0.1 dB steps (0 = -40 dB, 400 = 0 dB). 400 = 0 dB = OFF: the low band is not compressed. Default OFF.

params.name: HiThr
params.comment: High band threshold, same scale. Default OFF.

params.name: XOver
params.comment: Crossover, 0..20 = 60 to 400 Hz on a log scale (Linkwitz-Riley 24 dB/oct). Default 9 = 141 Hz.

params.name: Level
params.comment: Output level, 0..30 = -24 to +6 dB in 1 dB steps, on the whole output (dry and wet), before the -1 dBFS ceiling. Sets the effect's loudness against bypass; no change to the compression. Default 24 = 0 dB.

params.name: LoRat
params.comment: Low band ratio: 0 1.5:1, 1 2:1, 2 4:1, 3 10:1. No effect while LoThr is OFF. Default 4:1.

params.name: HiRat
params.comment: High band ratio: 0 1.5:1, 1 2:1, 2 4:1, 3 10:1. No effect while HiThr is OFF. Default 2:1.

params.name: Attck
params.comment: Attack, both bands: 0 0.1 ms, 1 0.3, 2 1, 3 3, 4 10, 5 30 ms. Default 10 ms.

params.name: Rels
params.comment: Release, both bands: 0 0.1 s, 1 0.3, 2 0.6, 3 1.2 s, 4 AUTO (program-dependent: 0.1 s after single peaks, up to 1.2 s after sustained reduction). Default AUTO.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Linear dry/wet inside each band (parallel compression): 0 = the summed bands uncompressed, 100 = fully compressed. Default 100.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
dsp_cost_comment: Estimate: Gooey (12) plus six state-variable filters a sample (three per side) and a second detector and gain computer per block. Re-measure on the pedal.
